alerts.title: Anode recycle vs expected below the -25% alarm limit
alerts.detail: Anode recycle vs expected is -53.0% (below the -25% alarm limit). Measured anode recycle flow compared with the flow the anode-loop mass balance requires.
alerts.hint: Low recycle means less steam at the anode inlet and a risk of nickel oxidation. Check the recycle blower or ejector and its valves.

blower_fade.label: Air blower fade
blower_fade.text: Blower capacity and efficiency fall; air cannot keep up at high load.

h2_restriction.label: Hydrogen supply restriction
h2_restriction.text: 12 % of the demanded H₂ stops arriving; fuel utilisation climbs.

recycle_loss.label: Anode recycle loss
recycle_loss.text: Recycle flow drops; less steam reaches the anode inlet.

dp_excursion.label: Differential-pressure spikes
dp_excursion.text: Repeated anode-cathode ΔP spikes above the warning band.

thermal_gradient.label: Air maldistribution
thermal_gradient.text: The real cathode temperature rise exceeds what the measured air flow explains.

sensor_drift.label: Thermocouple drift
sensor_drift.text: The cathode-outlet thermocouple drifts upward; the process itself is healthy.
